response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count FROM order_counts) SELECT oc.account_id, d.A3 AS region, oc.order_count, oc.order_count - ac.avg_order_count AS difference FROM order_counts AS oc JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac ORDER BY difference DESC, oc.account_id LIMIT 10
